AI Marketplace OS API v2.1.0: the full contract, embedded in this page so it opens straight from disk (the Swagger UI scripts load from cdn.jsdelivr.net, so the browser needs internet access). Generated; do not edit.

Pick a server in the Servers list. Staging and production are placeholders until the GCP rollout. "Try it out" needs the page to be served from an origin in the API's ALLOWED_ORIGINS; from a file on disk the browser blocks the calls. For live calls open the API's own Swagger UI at /docs (for example http://localhost:8000/docs; local and staging only, never production). Authorize with the access_token from POST /api/v1/auth/login.

Conventions (auth, idempotency, If-Match, paging, errors, jobs) are explained in API-REFERENCE.md next to this file.
